title: Hybrids defined without decorator return error when queried as a separate attribute

labels.name: regression
labels.description: something worked and was broken by a change

body:
**Describe the bug**

In SA 1.4 hybrid property defined without decorator returns error when queried as a separate attribute.

**Expected behavior**

The given query should work.

**To Reproduce**

```py
import sqlalchemy as sa
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.ext.hybrid import hybrid_property
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

Base = declarative_base()

dsn = 'postgresql://postgres:@localhost/test'
engine = sa.create_engine(dsn)
connection = engine.connect()


class City(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'city'
    id = sa.Column(sa.Integer, primary_key=True)

    @hybrid_property
    def some_hybrid(self):
        return self.id

    some_hybrid2 = hybrid_property(lambda self: self.id)


sa.orm.configure_mappers()
Base.metadata.create_all(connection)
Session = sessionmaker(bind=connection)
session = Session()

print(session.query(City).all())  # works!
print(session.query(City.some_hybrid).all())  # works!
print(session.query(City.some_hybrid2).all())  # throws error :(

```

**Versions.**
 - SQLAlchemy: 1.4

**Additional context**

We've been trying to get SA-Utils to support SA 1.4. This bug is currently causing problem with [SA-Utils translation hybrid](https://github.com/kvesteri/sqlalchemy-utils/blob/master/sqlalchemy_utils/i18n.py)
